# Workflow

A Loom-side definition of a workflow over one protocol: an ordered list of steps, each either deterministic (one action with literal arguments, proposed without a model) or a judgement (the actions a model may choose among, with instructions). A step may be conditional on a frontier claim, never on a model.

`loom.workflow` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `DeterministicStep`

`loom.workflow.DeterministicStep` is a record of two fields:

- `action` — `String`
- `arguments` — `Json`

### `JudgementStep`

`loom.workflow.JudgementStep` is a record of three fields:

- `actions` — `List<String>`
- `instructions` — `String`
- `inputs` — `List<loom.workflow.OutputReference>`

### `OutputReference`

`loom.workflow.OutputReference` is a record of two fields:

- `step` — `String`
- `output` — `String`

### `OutputType`

`loom.workflow.OutputType` is one of `String`, `Integer`, `Boolean`, `Json`, `StringList`, `IntegerList`, `BooleanList` and `JsonList`.

### `StepCondition`

`loom.workflow.StepCondition` is a record of two fields:

- `claim` — `String`
- `value` — `loom.workflow.Truth`

### `StepKind`

`loom.workflow.StepKind` is one of two shapes, told apart by a `kind` field — tagged, so a decoder never has to guess which branch it is reading:

- `Deterministic` — `loom.workflow.DeterministicStep`
- `Judgement` — `loom.workflow.JudgementStep`

### `StepOutput`

`loom.workflow.StepOutput` is a record of three fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `pointer` — `String`
- `type` — `loom.workflow.OutputType`

### `Truth`

`loom.workflow.Truth` is one of `True`, `False` and `Unknown`.

### `WorkflowDefinition`

`loom.workflow.WorkflowDefinition` is a record of three fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `protocol` — `String`
- `steps` — `List<loom.workflow.WorkflowStep>`

### `WorkflowStep`

`loom.workflow.WorkflowStep` is a record of four fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `when` — `Optional<loom.workflow.StepCondition>`, which may be absent
- `kind` — `loom.workflow.StepKind`
- `outputs` — `List<loom.workflow.StepOutput>`

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `loom.workflow.WorkflowDefinition`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
